title: Pinned-fixed beam with a linearly varying load on part of the span

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.location: 'V. Deflection and Reactions in a Beam' (https://docs.bentley.com/LiveContent/web/STAAD.Pro%20Help-v21/en/GUID-42CF0C95-4031-4EB9-8BEF-3E3BA17D9CBC.html)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Roark's Formulas for Stress and Strain (W. C. Young), 6th ed., Table 3, case 2c, p. 103 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Beam of 7.5 m, pinned at A (x = 0), built in at B; line load from 4 kN/m at x = 3 m to 7 kN/m at B (downward); Iz = 5000 cm^4, A = 50 cm^2, E = 200 kN/mm^2. Units kN, m. First-order analysis, no shear deformation. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
